desc.zh: 最基础的操作单元，内置六种主题、四种尺寸，支持镂空、加载态与渐变色。
desc.en: The most basic action unit: six themes, four sizes, plus plain, loading and gradient variants.

desc.zh: 内置字体图标库，同时支持传入图片路径作为图标使用。
desc.en: A built-in icon font, which also accepts an image path in place of a glyph.

desc.zh: 增强版图片组件，提供加载中、加载失败占位与淡入动画。
desc.en: An enhanced image with loading and error placeholders plus a fade-in transition.

desc.zh: 对文本做了主题、省略、脱敏与格式化封装，适合手机号、金额、日期等场景。
desc.en: Text with theming, truncation, masking and formatting for phone numbers, money and dates.

desc.zh: 用于标记关键字或分类，支持镂空、圆角与可关闭样式。
desc.en: Marks keywords or categories; supports plain, rounded and closable styles.

desc.zh: 出现在图标或文字右上角的数字或圆点，用于提示未读数量。
desc.en: A number or dot pinned to the corner of an icon to signal unread items.

desc.zh: 展示用户头像，支持图片、文字、图标三种内容与头像组堆叠。
desc.en: Shows a user avatar from an image, text or icon, and can stack into a group.

desc.zh: 点击后跳转外部链接或复制到剪贴板，自动处理各端差异。
desc.en: Opens an external URL or copies it to the clipboard, smoothing over platform gaps.

desc.zh: 统一的标题排版，提供多级字号与前缀装饰。
desc.en: Consistent heading typography with several levels and an optional prefix accent.

desc.zh: 纯 CSS/原生绘制的加载指示器，提供圆环、花朵、半圆三种形态。
desc.en: A loading indicator drawn natively, in circle, flower or semicircle form.

desc.zh: 覆盖整个页面的加载遮罩，适合首屏或路由切换时使用。
desc.en: A full-page loading cover for first paint or route transitions.

desc.zh: 为元素的进入与离开提供淡入、缩放、滑动等预设动画。
desc.en: Fade, zoom and slide presets for element enter and leave.

desc.zh: 一键将文本写入系统剪贴板，并给出统一的成功反馈。
desc.en: Writes text to the system clipboard with consistent success feedback.

desc.zh: 24 等分的行列栅格，用于快速搭建等宽或按比例分栏的结构。
desc.en: A 24-column row/col grid for equal-width or proportional layouts.

desc.zh: 列表项的通用容器，可组合标题、描述、图标、右侧箭头与自定义内容。
desc.en: The general-purpose list row: title, label, icon, arrow and custom content.

desc.zh: 带头部、内容与底部三段结构的卡片容器。
desc.en: A card container with head, body and foot sections.

desc.zh: 等分的宫格布局，常用于首页金刚区与功能入口。
desc.en: An evenly divided grid, typically used for home-screen shortcuts.

desc.zh: 可控制方向、长度、颜色与虚实的一根线。
desc.en: A single line with configurable direction, length, colour and dash style.

desc.zh: 区隔内容的分割线，支持居中或靠边的文字说明。
desc.en: A content separator that can carry centred or aligned text.

desc.zh: 用于制造区块之间的留白，可设置高度与背景色。
desc.en: Whitespace between blocks, with configurable height and background.

desc.zh: 带内边距、圆角与阴影的基础容器，替代手写 view 样式。
desc.en: A basic container with padding, radius and shadow, so you write less CSS.

desc.zh: 滚动到指定位置时将内容固定在顶部。
desc.en: Pins content to the top once scrolling passes a threshold.

desc.zh: 图片或自定义内容的轮播容器，内置多种指示器样式。
desc.en: A carousel for images or custom content, with several indicator styles.

desc.zh: 横向滚动的列表容器，附带自定义滚动条指示。
desc.en: A horizontally scrolling list with its own scrollbar indicator.

desc.zh: 双列不等高瀑布流布局，自动把新内容放进较短的一列。
desc.en: A two-column masonry layout that always fills the shorter column next.

desc.zh: 为 iPhone 等带 Home 指示条的机型撑出底部安全距离。
desc.en: Reserves the bottom safe-area inset on devices with a home indicator.

desc.zh: 撑出与系统状态栏等高的占位空间，配合自定义导航栏使用。
desc.en: A spacer as tall as the system status bar, for custom nav bars.

desc.zh: 表单容器与校验器，配合 form-item 完成规则校验与错误提示。
desc.en: A form container and validator that pairs with form-item for rules and errors.

desc.zh: 单行输入框，支持前后插槽、清除按钮、密码显隐与字数统计。
desc.en: A single-line input with prefix/suffix slots, clear button, password toggle and counter.

desc.zh: 多行输入框，支持自动增高与字数限制。
desc.en: A multi-line input that grows with content and can enforce a length limit.

desc.zh: 多选控件，支持组合校验、横竖排列与自定义图标。
desc.en: Multi-select control with group validation, layout options and custom icons.

desc.zh: 单选控件，支持组合校验、横竖排列与自定义图标。
desc.en: Single-select control with group validation, layout options and custom icons.

desc.zh: 两种状态之间的切换控件，支持异步确认后再改变状态。
desc.en: Toggles between two states, optionally awaiting async confirmation first.

desc.zh: 通过拖动滑块在连续或离散区间内取值。
desc.en: Pick a value from a continuous or stepped range by dragging.

desc.zh: 星级评分控件，支持半星、只读与自定义图标。
desc.en: A star rating control with half stars, read-only mode and custom icons.

desc.zh: 搜索输入框，内置搜索按钮、清除按钮与历史提示接口。
desc.en: A search field with built-in search and clear buttons.

desc.zh: 数字加减控件，支持步长、上下限与长按连加。
desc.en: A numeric stepper with step size, bounds and press-and-hold repetition.

desc.zh: 图片与文件上传，内置选择、预览、删除与进度展示。
desc.en: Image and file upload with selection, preview, removal and progress.

desc.zh: 单列或多列的滚动选择器，支持联动数据。
desc.en: A single- or multi-column scroll picker, including cascading data.

desc.zh: 日期与时间选择器，可自由组合年月日时分秒。
desc.en: A date and time picker; compose year, month, day, hour, minute and second freely.

desc.zh: 日历选择器，支持单日、多日与区间选择。
desc.en: A calendar picker supporting single, multiple and range selection.

desc.zh: 自定义键盘，提供数字、身份证与车牌号三种布局。
desc.en: Custom keyboards: numeric, ID-card and licence-plate layouts.

desc.zh: 无 UI 的倒计时逻辑组件，配合按钮实现"重新获取验证码"。
desc.en: A headless countdown that drives a "resend verification code" button.

desc.zh: 格子式验证码输入框，支持下划线、方框与横线三种样式。
desc.en: A boxed verification-code field, in box, underline or dash style.

name.zh: Message input 验证码输入框

desc.zh: 与 code-input 类似的短信验证码输入，可自动聚焦与自动提交。
desc.en: An SMS-code field similar to code-input, with autofocus and auto-submit.

desc.zh: 从底部弹出的列表选择器，适合选项较少的场景。
desc.en: A bottom-sheet list picker, ideal when there are few options.

desc.zh: 多级联动选择器，常用于省市区、分类等树形数据。
desc.en: A cascading picker for tree data such as regions or categories.

desc.zh: 数据驱动的通用选择器，一个组件覆盖单选、多选与搜索。
desc.en: A data-driven picker covering single select, multi select and search in one.

desc.zh: 取色面板，支持色相、饱和度与透明度调节。
desc.en: A colour panel with hue, saturation and alpha controls.

desc.zh: 按九宫格排布的图片集合，点击可全屏预览。
desc.en: A grid of images with full-screen preview on tap.

desc.zh: 手写签名画板，可导出为图片。
desc.en: A handwriting signature pad that exports to an image.

desc.zh: 图片裁剪器，支持缩放、旋转与固定比例。
desc.en: An image cropper with zoom, rotation and fixed aspect ratios.

desc.zh: 城市列表选择器，带索引与定位当前城市能力。
desc.en: A city list picker with an index bar and current-location support.

desc.zh: 用户协议勾选控件，内置未勾选时的抖动提示。
desc.en: A terms-of-service checkbox that shakes when unchecked.

desc.zh: 轻量的全局提示，支持成功、失败、加载等主题与完成回调。
desc.en: A lightweight global message with success, error and loading themes plus a completion callback.

desc.zh: 从屏幕顶部滑入的通知条，适合非阻塞的结果反馈。
desc.en: A banner sliding in from the top for non-blocking feedback.

desc.zh: 居中弹出的对话框，支持确认/取消、异步关闭与自定义内容。
desc.en: A centred dialog with confirm/cancel, async close and custom content.

desc.zh: 从上下左右或中间弹出的通用容器，是许多组件的底座。
desc.en: A generic container popping from any edge or the centre; the base of many components.

desc.zh: 半透明遮罩，用于突出弹出内容并拦截背景交互。
desc.en: A translucent scrim that highlights a layer and blocks background interaction.

desc.zh: 从底部弹起的操作列表，支持标题、描述与危险操作样式。
desc.en: A bottom action list with title, description and destructive styling.

desc.zh: 常驻页面的提示条，用于说明需要关注但不打断流程的信息。
desc.en: An inline banner for information that matters but should not interrupt.

desc.zh: 横向滚动或纵向轮播的公告栏。
desc.en: An announcement bar that scrolls horizontally or rotates vertically.

desc.zh: 长按或点击后出现的气泡文字，可附带复制操作。
desc.en: A text bubble on tap or long press, optionally with a copy action.

desc.zh: 锚定在元素旁的气泡面板，可放入菜单或任意内容。
desc.en: A bubble panel anchored to an element, holding a menu or any content.

desc.zh: 左滑或右滑露出操作按钮，常用于列表项删除。
desc.en: Swipe a row to reveal action buttons, typically delete.

desc.zh: 可展开收起的内容面板，支持手风琴模式。
desc.en: Expandable panels, with an optional accordion mode.

desc.zh: 高亮页面局部并配以说明的新手引导蒙层。
desc.en: An onboarding overlay that spotlights part of the screen and explains it.

desc.zh: 悬浮在页面之上的操作按钮，可展开为多个子操作。
desc.en: A floating action button that can fan out into several sub-actions.

desc.zh: 弹出层顶部的取消/确认工具条，选择器类组件的公共部件。
desc.en: The cancel/confirm bar at the top of a popup; shared by picker components.

desc.zh: 电商商品规格选择弹层，处理规格组合与库存联动。
desc.en: An e-commerce SKU sheet handling attribute combinations and stock.

desc.zh: 替代系统导航栏，自动处理状态栏高度与返回逻辑。
desc.en: Replaces the system nav bar, handling status-bar height and back navigation.

desc.zh: 底部标签栏，支持徽标、凸起中间项与安全区适配。
desc.en: A bottom tab bar with badges, a raised centre item and safe-area handling.

desc.zh: 横向标签页，支持滚动、徽标与自定义滑块。
desc.en: Horizontal tabs with scrolling, badges and a customisable indicator.

desc.zh: 两到多个选项之间的分段切换控件。
desc.en: A segmented control for switching between a few options.

desc.zh: 展示流程进度，支持横向、纵向与自定义节点。
desc.en: Shows progress through a flow, horizontally or vertically, with custom nodes.

desc.zh: 从导航区域展开的筛选菜单，常用于列表页排序与过滤。
desc.en: A filter menu dropping from a nav area, for sorting and filtering lists.

desc.zh: 带右侧字母索引的长列表，滚动时自动吸顶分组标题。
desc.en: A long list with an alphabet index and sticky group headers.

name.zh: Back to top 返回顶部

desc.zh: 滚动一段距离后出现的回到顶部按钮。
desc.en: A back-to-top button that appears after scrolling far enough.

desc.zh: 分页导航控件，支持上下页与页码跳转。
desc.en: Page navigation with prev/next and direct page jumps.

desc.zh: 空状态占位图，内置多种语义化插画。
desc.en: An empty-state placeholder with several built-in illustrations.

desc.zh: 断网时的全屏提示，提供重试与跳转系统设置入口。
desc.en: A full-screen offline notice with retry and system-settings shortcuts.

desc.zh: 左侧分类、右侧内容的二级联动导航。
desc.en: Two-level navigation with categories on the left and content on the right.

desc.zh: 带右侧"更多"入口的区块标题。
desc.en: A block heading with an optional "more" affordance on the right.

desc.zh: 可展开收起的层级数据展示，支持复选与懒加载。
desc.en: Hierarchical data with expand/collapse, checkboxes and lazy loading.

desc.zh: 为长列表做了回收优化的容器，配合 list-item 使用。
desc.en: A recycling container for long lists, used with list-item.

desc.zh: 只渲染可视区域的虚拟滚动列表，可承载上万条数据。
desc.en: Renders only the visible window, so it scales to tens of thousands of rows.

desc.zh: 数据表格，支持固定表头、自定义列与单元格插槽。
desc.en: A data table with a fixed header, custom columns and cell slots.

desc.zh: 加载中的占位骨架，支持段落、头像与图片形状。
desc.en: Loading placeholders in paragraph, avatar and image shapes.

desc.zh: 横向进度条，可在条内显示百分比。
desc.en: A horizontal progress bar that can show its percentage inline.

desc.zh: 环形进度指示器，适合展示完成度与得分。
desc.en: A ring progress indicator for completion rates and scores.

desc.zh: 毫秒级倒计时，支持自定义时间格式与插槽渲染。
desc.en: A millisecond countdown with custom formats and slot rendering.

desc.zh: 数字从起始值滚动到目标值的动画。
desc.en: Animates a number from a start value to a target value.

desc.zh: 列表底部的加载状态提示，包含加载中、加载完成与没有更多三态。
desc.en: A list footer with loading, loaded and no-more states.

name.zh: Read more 展开阅读更多

desc.zh: 超出指定高度时折叠内容并给出展开按钮。
desc.en: Collapses content past a height threshold and offers an expand button.

desc.zh: 进入视口后才真正加载图片，减少首屏请求。
desc.en: Defers image loading until it enters the viewport.

desc.zh: 下拉触发刷新的容器，支持自定义下拉区域内容。
desc.en: A pull-to-refresh container with a customisable pull area.

desc.zh: 长按拖动重新排序的列表或宫格。
desc.en: A list or grid reordered by long-press and drag.

desc.zh: 优惠券卡片样式，含票根缺口与可用/失效状态。
desc.en: A coupon card with ticket notches and available/expired states.

desc.zh: 把 HTML 字符串解析为各端原生节点渲染。
desc.en: Parses an HTML string into native nodes on every platform.

desc.zh: 渲染 Markdown 文本，支持代码块与表格。
desc.en: Renders Markdown text, including code blocks and tables.

desc.zh: 在本地生成二维码，无需服务端参与。
desc.en: Generates a QR code locally, with no server round trip.

desc.zh: 在本地生成一维条形码。
desc.en: Generates a one-dimensional barcode locally.

desc.zh: 将图文合成为一张可保存分享的海报图片。
desc.en: Composites text and images into a shareable poster.

desc.zh: 统一各端差异的画布封装，是二维码、海报等组件的底层。
desc.en: A canvas wrapper that hides platform differences; the base for QR codes and posters.

desc.zh: 内嵌 PDF 浏览器，支持翻页与缩放。
desc.en: An embedded PDF viewer with paging and zoom.

desc.zh: 全屏上下滑动的短视频播放容器。
desc.en: A full-screen, vertically swipeable short-video player.

desc.zh: 带目录、翻页与阅读设置的长文阅读器。
desc.en: A long-form reader with catalogue, paging and reading settings.

desc.zh: 最底层的视图容器，统一各端的盒模型与样式写法。
desc.en: The lowest-level view container, unifying the box model across platforms.
